title:
En bloc
*just got easier*

lines.say: You own a unit in an older condo. From now on, a collective sale could be easier to pass.
In September 2026, Parliament passed changes to the en bloc rules.
For estates aged 40 to 59 years, consent drops from 80% to 70%.
Under 10 years still needs 90%. 10 to 39 years stays at 80%.
So in older estates, fewer neighbours can block a sale.
Want to know if your estate could be next? Comment CHECK.

caption:
Own a unit in an older condo? A collective sale could now be easier to pass. 🏢

In September 2026, Parliament passed changes to the en bloc rules:
40 to 59 years: consent drops from 80% to 70%
60 years and above: 65%
Under 10 years still 90%. 10 to 39 years stays at 80%.

So in older estates, fewer neighbours can block a sale.

Want to know if your estate could be next? Comment CHECK 👇
